title: Customers were vanishing from this shop

lines.tts: [low, noir] Customers were vanishing from this shop. Without a trace.
lines.text: Customers were vanishing from this shop. Without a trace.

lines.tts: [panicked] They walk in, they fill the damn cart... and then they're gone!
lines.text: They walk in, they fill the damn cart... and then they're gone!

lines.tts: [low, noir] So I followed one. The shop: fine. The cart: fine.
lines.text: So I followed one. The shop: fine. The cart: fine.

lines.tts: [low, noir, building, a little faster] Then: create an account. Confirm your email.
lines.text: Then: create an account. Confirm your email.

lines.tts: [slow, ominous] And then... confirm your password.
[low, noir, slow] There it was. The killer.
[low] Forced sign-ups alone scare off about one in five shoppers.
lines.text: Forced sign-ups alone scare off about one in five shoppers.

lines.tts: [low] Every extra step is a leak. Find it. Cut it.
lines.text: Every extra step is a leak. Find it. Cut it.

lines.tts: [grateful] Detective, how do I pay you?
lines.text: Detective, how do I pay you?

lines.tts: Comment FUNNEL for the free leak checklist.
